displayPattern: Dual 7-segment display on a Rheem R96V / (-)96V furnace (installation instructions 92-24161-124-03): d1
meaning: No model data. This is a critical fault. The furnace will not operate in any mode, including a thermostat call.
causes: Memory card missing from the furnace control, or disconnected from connector P6
Furnace control replaced without the original memory card installed in the replacement
diySteps: Write down d1. The manual says a missing card shows d4 instead when model data is already on the network

Technician: install the original memory card in connector P6. If it cannot be found, the manual says a replacement is ordered from ProStock for that furnace model. Power must be cycled off and on after the card is installed or the data will not be read
Technician: do not install a memory card from another furnace or from a condenser or air handler. The manual says the wrong card can damage the heat exchanger
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. d1 means the furnace has no model data and will not run.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
sourceTitle: Rheem (-)96V series installation instructions 92-24161-124-03, Table 20 R96V fault codes. Read 2026-11-07
